connections.observation: The dense recurrence of παιδεύω forms (s001) and of μῦθος forms (s002) is interlaced by the fourfold πρότερον (s013): each πρότερον places μουσική, ψευδῆ, or μῦθοι ahead of gymnastics or exercises, so that the priority markers fall between the recurring παιδ- and μυθ- words rather than beside either alone.

πλάττω (s003) shifts subject from the young child, to fabricated μῦθοι, to souls molded by μῦθοι; the ψυχή/σῶμα pair (s006) reappears exactly at the third πλάττειν, where molding souls with μῦθοι is set beside molding σώματα with hands; τύπος (s007) sits between these, first as what is stamped on the young and then as what greater and lesser μῦθοι must share.

The ἀληθές/ψεῦδος division of λόγοι (s004) is applied to μῦθοι (s002), which are called mostly ψεῦδος with ἀληθῆ inside; then the ἐγκριτέον/ἀποκριτέον pair (s009) sorts μῦθοι by καλόν, not by the earlier true/false division, so the criterion of selection displaces the criterion of division.

σκοπέω and σκέψις (s011) cluster at the opening around κατιδεῖν justice; ὀψόμεθα (s016) closes the section with seeing directed at μείζους μῦθοι. The verbs of looking frame the section, with justice at one end and μῦθοι at the other.
θρέψονται opens with rearing (s012); τροφούς return as those who will speak the approved μῦθοι and πλάττειν souls (s003, s012), so that the nurses who feed become the nurses who mold.
The etymological echo μύθῳ μυθολογοῦντές (s010) stands at the first occurrence of μῦθος in the section; the subsequent six occurrences of μῦθος-words (s002) unfold from that doubled opening.
The conjunction of ἀρχή, νέῳ, ἁπαλῷ (s014) precedes and prepares the first πλάττεται and τύπος (s003, s007): softness and beginning stand immediately before the language of molding and stamping.

elements.context: τοὺς ἐπιτυχόντας ὑπὸ τῶν ἐπιτυχόντων μύθους πλασθέντας

new_signals.observation: ἐπιτυχόντας and ἐπιτυχόντων occur adjacently, the same participle applied both to the children who hear and to those who fabricate the μῦθοι.
A cluster of verbal adjectives in -τέον accumulates across 377a–c, each stating an obligation regarding education, oversight, selection, and rejection.
